clips.text: Pixel Reel is for anyone who would rather watch than read. Which, let's be honest, is most of us.
If reading is hard work, with dyslexia, say, or just tired eyes, let the reel do the reading for you.
If your mind likes to wander, short scenes keep things moving. One idea, then the next.
If you're short on time, most reels are done in two minutes. That's about one cup of tea.
And it's good for children. Volcanoes. Fractions. Why the sky is blue. It's homework, but a cartoon.
